title: Tax audit
covers: this year against last, with flags
the Form 3CD checklist for this client
audit points and who clears them

steps.say: Work through a tax audit in SimplyFile: is one needed, what moved since last year, the Form 3CD clauses that apply, and the points still open.
Choose the client; the year is picked at the top.
From the turnover in the mapped books: above 1 crore for a business, 10 crore when cash is within 5%, 50 lakh for a profession, or presumptive with a lower profit. Tick what the books cannot show.

Every mapped P&L and balance-sheet line against last year - from last year's statements, last year's filed return, or this year's previous-year column. New, gone, sharp moves and lines growing faster than turnover are flagged.
One click turns a flagged line into an audit point.
Only the clauses that apply to this client - partners, TDS, loans, stock and more. Mark each one with a note; an issue opens an audit point.
What still needs an answer before the report is signed, each with who answers it. A preparer raises points; a reviewer, auditor, partner or firm admin clears them.
